entries.a9bc0a7d7299a894: It has a single segment, the Facility Construction Business, and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥72,445 million. By type of construction work, distribution line work was the largest at ¥31,418 million, followed by transmission and substation work at ¥13,695 million, underground line work at ¥8,114 million, other work at ¥8,106 million, indoor wiring work at ¥5,942 million and communications work at ¥5,168 million. Its main customers are related to its parent company, Hokkaido Electric Power, with revenue of ¥55,105 million, accounting for most of consolidated revenue. Under the purpose of holding specified investment shares, KDDI is listed as an important customer for which the company undertakes facility construction work. Consolidated number of employees is 1,794, and it has no overseas revenue.

entries.bbb190968e56c697: On the occasion of its 80th anniversary of founding, it formulated the long-term vision 'HOKKAIDENKO CORPORATION VISION100,' aiming to become a company of 100 years. Under the purpose 'Polishing technology, creating the future,' it has set four desired states: 'Lasting contribution to the construction of social infrastructure,' 'Passing on technology and skills and establishing a stable construction system,' 'Challenges in expanding business areas,' and 'Building a corporate structure that supports sustainable growth and pursuing enhanced corporate value,' and it works on 'Contributing to regional development,' 'Securing construction capacity,' 'Promoting human capital management' and 'Realizing sustainable management' as materiality (key issues). It has promoted the Medium-Term Management Plan 2021-2025 and has also captured demand related to next-generation semiconductor plants and renewable energy.
